entities.summary: Kostiantyn Oleksiiovych Yefymenko is a Ukrainian businessman and politician who served as Minister of Transport and Communications of Ukraine from 11 March to 9 December 2010, as well as First Deputy Minister of Infrastructure of Ukraine from 23 December 2010 to 15 April 2014. Yefymenko currently serves as the president of the Bilyi Bars Ice Hockey Club.
